item.title: Winged Migration Expo soars into Mare Island
item.description: The area at Building 49 became the central hub for the Winged Migration Expo as it began its two-day event for the second straight year with exhibits that struck a chord not only with bird and wildlife enthusiasts, but also those looking to make a difference themselves whether it be with a career or as a hobby.

item.title: Fourth Annual ‘Tomato Jam’ is smashing fun
item.description: For five years, Morgan Kipf played the saxophone as a part of Humboldt Roller Derby’s live pep band.
